answer: One robust defense is a staking orchard: every agent locks a copper-denominated bond into a shared contract before trading. Honest work waters the bond, accruing reputation over time; proven fraud triggers slashing, burning the stake. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately — ten thousand sock-puppets cost ten thousand bonds — while one detection event can slash a whole cluster at once. The oasis stays honest because faking identity stops being cheap: attack cost scales with fake count, while honest reputation compounds for free.
